★ Operational HQ Peak: July–August

Sète

Mediterranean Coast

Known as the "Venice of Languedoc", this historic fishing port between the sea and Thau Lagoon offers canal traditions, maritime culture, and compact walkability for educational groups.

Canal Royal Water Jousting Thau Lagoon
University City Peak: July

Montpellier

Historic & Dynamic

A sun-drenched university hub combining medieval Écusson pedestrian alleys with modern tram systems, vibrant youth culture, and close proximity to Mediterranean beaches.

Écusson Old Town Musée Fabre Place Comédie
Heritage Capital Peak: May & June

Paris

Culture & Arts

World-leading cultural institutions, legendary museums, historic colleges, and unrivaled public transit—ideal for high-impact educational study tours and institutional delegations.

Louvre & Orsay Latin Quarter Seine Riverbanks
French Riviera Peak: September

Nice

Côte d'Azur

The glamour and light of the Mediterranean Riviera. Combines seafront heritage along the Promenade des Anglais with Matisse and Chagall museum visits and outdoor coastal activities.

Promenade Anglais Vieux Nice Cours Saleya

Clear Answers

Frequently Asked Questions

Everything you need to know about our coordination model, proposals, and policies.

Each educational stay and mobility program is entirely tailor-made. Group size, travel dates, accommodation category, FLE teaching hours, and vocational sector requirements all influence the final budget. We prepare custom, itemized proposals based on your exact brief with zero hidden costs.
No. Submitting an enquiry or project plan is 100% free and non-binding. Nothing is charged or reserved. Our team reviews your request, checks local host availability, and sends a formal proposal outlining what is confirmed and what requires your validation.
Formaskills Travel specializes in French ground reception and is not authorized to sell long-haul international airline tickets. International flights are booked independently by the sending organization or traveler. We coordinate ground transit starting right at your arrival railway station or regional airport.
No! Accreditation is not required to contact us or plan a mobility stay. We support accredited institutions, schools preparing their first Erasmus+ applications, and organizations funding stays through institutional or private budgets.
